# Alalam et al. 2022 (RNA journal) - Global SLAM-seq
# GSE196690
# S5: per-gene half-life estimates for WT and upf3Δ (3 replicates each)
# S7: list of transcripts with significantly altered half-life (NMD targets)
# Output: tables/df_alalam_gba.txt
#         figures/Alalam_NMD_violin.png
#         figures/Alalam_scatter_vs_hl_fc.png
#         figures/Alalam_NMD_sensitive_violin.png

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)

col_small <- "#784283"
col_large <- "#ffa8cb"
col_A <- "#e5000c"

# Load GBA functions
load("scripts/gba_functions.rda")
```

```{r load-data}
# Per-gene half-life estimates for WT and upf3Δ (S5)
df_hl <- read.csv("tables/S5_full_dataset_hl_both_strains_unfiltered.csv")

# NMD target list (S7)
df_nmd <- read.csv("tables/S7_full_list_of_transcripts_with_altered_half_life.csv")

# WT half-life fold change (size-dependent stability, our data)
df_fc <- read.table("output_tables/df_WT_consensus_hl_fc.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t")
```

```{r process}
df_alalam <- df_hl %>%
  mutate(
    hl_wt_mean = rowMeans(across(c(hl_wt_rep1, hl_wt_rep2, hl_wt_rep3)), na.rm = TRUE),
    hl_upf3_mean = rowMeans(across(c(hl_UPF3_rep1, hl_UPF3_rep2, hl_UPF3_rep3)), na.rm = TRUE),
    n_wt = rowSums(!is.na(across(c(hl_wt_rep1, hl_wt_rep2, hl_wt_rep3)))),
    n_upf3 = rowSums(!is.na(across(c(hl_UPF3_rep1, hl_UPF3_rep2, hl_UPF3_rep3))))
  ) %>%
  filter(n_wt >= 2, n_upf3 >= 2) %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC_upf3_hl = log2(hl_upf3_mean / hl_wt_mean),
    nmd_sensitive = name %in% df_nmd[[1]]
  ) %>%
  select(name, hl_wt_mean, hl_upf3_mean, log2FC_upf3_hl, nmd_sensitive)

cat("Genes after filtering:", nrow(df_alalam), "\n")
cat("NMD-sensitive genes:", sum(df_alalam$nmd_sensitive), "\n")
summary(df_alalam$log2FC_upf3_hl)
```

```{r merge}
# Merge with our WT half-life fold change
df_merged <- df_alalam %>%
  inner_join(df_fc, by = "name")

cat("Genes after merging with WT hl FC:", nrow(df_merged), "\n")
```

```{r figure1-scatter}
# Scatter: log2FC_upf3_hl vs WT half-life FC (size-dependent stability)
r_val <- cor(df_merged$log2FC_upf3_hl, df_merged$log2_hl_fc,
             method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")

p1 <- ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = log2FC_upf3_hl, y = log2_hl_fc)) +
  geom_point(colour = col_large, alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(colour = "black", se = FALSE, span = 0.4) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
           label = paste0("R = ", round(r_val, 3)),
           size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 3.2,
           label = paste0("n = ", format(nrow(df_merged), big.mark = ",")),
           size = 5, colour = "grey40") +
  labs(
    title = "NMD sensitivity vs size-dependent mRNA stability",
    x = "log2 half-life FC (upf3\u03b4 / WT, Alalam et al. 2022)",
    y = "log2 half-life FC (large / small cells)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

print(p1)
ggsave("figures/Alalam_scatter_vs_hl_fc.png", p1, width = 5, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure2-nmd-violin}
# Violin: NMD-sensitive vs non-sensitive genes, WT half-life FC
p2 <- ggplot(df_merged, aes(x = nmd_sensitive, y = log2_hl_fc,
                              fill = nmd_sensitive)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = col_large, "TRUE" = col_small),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Non-NMD", "TRUE" = "NMD-sensitive")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("FALSE" = "Non-NMD", "TRUE" = "NMD-sensitive")) +
  labs(
    title = "Size-dependent stability by NMD sensitivity",
    x = "Gene class (Alalam et al. 2022)",
    y = "log2 half-life FC (large / small cells)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p2)
ggsave("figures/Alalam_NMD_sensitive_violin.png", p2, width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure3-upf3-violin}
# Violin: upf3Δ half-life FC distribution by NMD sensitivity (sanity check)
p3 <- ggplot(df_alalam, aes(x = nmd_sensitive, y = log2FC_upf3_hl,
                              fill = nmd_sensitive)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.08, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = col_large, "TRUE" = col_small),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Non-NMD", "TRUE" = "NMD-sensitive")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("FALSE" = "Non-NMD", "TRUE" = "NMD-sensitive")) +
  labs(
    title = "Half-life FC in upf3\u03b4 by NMD sensitivity (sanity check)",
    x = "Gene class (Alalam et al. 2022)",
    y = "log2 half-life FC (upf3\u03b4 / WT)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(p3)
ggsave("figures/Alalam_upf3_violin.png", p3, width = 4, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r save}
write.table(df_alalam, "tables/df_alalam_gba.txt", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat("Saved to tables/df_alalam_gba.txt\n")
```
